purpose: Test two previously frozen QUBO objectives on the post-hoc PPARA Train-374 by Stage51-passing20 matrix against direct greedy, nested greedy, strong classical, additive, random, single-receptor, and all-receptor baselines.

evidence_timing.experiment_class: post-hoc PPARA train-only transfer of objectives frozen before PPARA functional scores

coverage_qubo.normalization: per-seed per-receptor empirical CDF fitted on the outer-train rows only

rank_pair_qubo.rank_normalization: per-seed per-receptor empirical CDF fitted on outer-train rows only
rank_pair_qubo.pair_complementarity: delta_ij=q_{ij}-max(q_i,q_j), where q_{ij} uses the better rank from receptor i or j
rank_pair_qubo.fixed_k_qubo: Q_k(S)=mean_{i in S}(q_i)+mean_{i<j in S}(delta_ij); for k=1 the pair term is zero
rank_pair_qubo.normalization_reason: separate normalization at each fixed k removes the Stage42d cardinality pressure and implements the previously proposed k=1..6 ladder
rank_pair_qubo.qubo_form: For each frozen k, maximize sum_i(q_i/k)x_i + sum_{i<j}(delta_ij/C(k,2))x_i x_j subject to sum_i x_i=k.

required_comparators: beam-64 plus multi-start fixed-k swap local search
direct greedy on the rank-pair QUBO
strong classical add/drop/swap search on the coverage objective
direct greedy on the coverage objective

support_gate.failure_action: Freeze the transferred objectives as unsupported on PPARA and forbid PPARA-specific weight tuning. Preserve any direct-greedy gap only as an optimization diagnostic, not an efficacy claim.

interpretation_boundary: Stage53 is train-only and post-hoc because the PPARA receptor pool was filtered using Stage51 outcomes. Scaffold holdouts test internal transfer only. A positive result can justify a new preregistered independent experiment, but cannot repair Stage51, establish QUBO superiority on independent data, authorize same-data tuning, or establish quantum execution, speedup, or advantage.
